summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Creative Global Technology Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, providing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 12, 2026. The meeting seeks shareholder approval for two proposals: (1) a special resolution to increase voting rights attached to each Class B ordinary share from 20 votes per share to 100 votes per share; and (2) an ordinary resolution to increase the authorized share capital from US$2,000,000 to US$90,000,000 by expanding the number of authorized Class A and Class B ordinary shares. Additionally, Proposal No. 3, a special resolution, is contingent on Proposal No. 2 passing and involves a capital reduction subject to a solvency statement under Cayman Islands law. These are routine governance and capital structure adjustments, not a special situation. The filing is analogous to a proxy statement in the US. The board is soliciting proxies and recommends approval. There are no deal terms, acquisition, or restructuring elements. Expect minimal trading impact; watch for shareholder approval outcomes.
